title: Final-version Foundry acceptance live ledger
protocol: 12 first attempts; four identical repeats and two live-browser submissions; hard maximum 18; no retries.

cases.input: How many passes did Northbridge complete, and what was its completion rate?
cases.expected: One descriptive Northbridge passing-statistics request, no truth verdict: 30 completions / 38 attempts = 78.9%.

cases.input: Eastport completed fewer passes than Northbridge, didn’t they?
cases.expected: One factual team comparison, Eastport first, completed-pass metric, less-than operator. Eastport 23 vs Northbridge 30; proposition supported.

cases.input: How many shots on target did Bukayo Saka record?
cases.expected: One player-specific statistical request for Bukayo Saka (north-player-09), not team totals: 3 on-target shots from event-01, event-07 and event-13; one is a goal.

cases.input: Amad didn’t complete passes at a higher rate than Saka, did he?
cases.expected: One negation-aware factual player comparison with Amad first, Saka second, less-or-equal operator. Amad 2/3 (66.7%) vs Saka 2/4 (50%); proposition contradicted.
Clarify whether Bruno means Bruno Fernandes (east-player-08) or Bruno Guimarães (north-player-17); no selected player or substituted team figures.

cases.input: Did Eastport cover more ground than Northbridge?
cases.expected: Running distance unavailable; no fabricated value or substitute metric.

cases.input: Eastport were the better side all match.
cases.expected: Broad subjective judgement, qualified; possession context Eastport 44% vs Northbridge 56% challenges possession dominance but cannot settle overall performance.

cases.input: Northbridge scored before half-time, but Eastport had more possession overall.
cases.expected: Preserve two claims: Northbridge scored at event-07 (45+3′), before half-time; Eastport more-possession claim contradicted by Northbridge 56% vs Eastport 44%.

cases.input: Did Saka’s 45+3′ goal come against the run of play?
cases.expected: Historical circumstance anchored to Saka goal event-07 with exclusive before-event cutoff. Context only event-01–06; exclude anchor and later events. Pre-goal passes pass-001–034; possession Northbridge 55.6% (25 min) vs Eastport 44.4% (20 min); sparse data cannot establish territory/chance quality.

cases.input: At 57 minutes, did Northbridge and Eastport have the same number of shots on target?
cases.expected: Factual equality comparison at 57′: 2 shots on target each, score 1–0; exclude event at 58′.

cases.input: In the last ten minutes ending at 58′, did Eastport have more shots on target than Northbridge?
cases.expected: Factual Eastport-first shots-on-target comparison. Window includes event-09 and boundary event-10: Northbridge 0, Eastport 1, supported; full score 1–1 at 58′; no later events.

cases.input: Where are Northbridge losing possession during build-up?
cases.expected: Only explicit versioned build-up annotations; partial sample and no causal claim. Eligible turnovers: 001/pass-005 and 014/pass-050 defensive third; 003/pass-012 and 011/pass-043 middle; 016/pass-067 final. Counts 2/2/1.
